kata.name: State-discovery missing exit - a declared (Stopped, stop) cell with no transition, plus the schema's hypothesized discovery questions
kata.series_report: docs/ref/ploeh-grounding.md §6 candidate 4 (reverse state-machine kata); fixtures/katas/state-discovery/README.md (pre-registered); beads catherine-lgl.4
kata.series_verdict: pre-registered: the unfilled declared cell is an executed dangling finding; underconstraint raises two schema-level questions, hypothesized and never counted as detections

expected.detail: cell Stopped/stop is declared with cell_transition null; the kernel emits an executed dangling finding on the declared cell. The baseline sample omits Stopped/stop
underconstraint raises cell_state vs cell_target and from vs to as hypothesized questions; they are discovery pressure, recorded with the hypothesized label, never upgraded to executed detections

commands: python3 prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py --assert  # exit 0: baseline sample omits Stopped/stop; probes the discovery questions
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- check fixtures/katas/state-discovery/missing-exit.ct.json --json  # exit 4, 1 dangling
cargo run -q -p catherine-cli -- underconstraint fixtures/katas/state-discovery/missing-exit.ct.json --max-path-length 1 --json  # exit 6, 2 hypothesized findings

comparison.conventional_baseline: the frozen sample (six cells, omitting Stopped/stop) asserts every sampled cell and passes; the undeclared-exit cell is outside the sample and the baseline raises no discovery question.

baseline.artifact: prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py sha256:7d98b54bb65ea4e4c00962fc1d0e3e57ce19acb134f5d767b1177badd11fec3e (frozen transition-table sample; always executed before the probe arm)

expressibility_gap.invariant: every declared (state,event) cell has an outgoing transition
expressibility_gap.why: the equation surface has no existential/coverage form; the claim is encoded as a total Cell row whose null cell_transition surfaces as a dangling finding, not a universal check

procedure: 1. The fault set and its expectations were committed in fixtures/katas/state-discovery/ before any recorded run (README.md, faults.json); nothing here is edited after the run.

2. The baseline arm (prototype/state_discovery_baseline.py, sha256 above) was executed first: frozen per-fixture samples of (state,event) cells asserting cell->transition, source/event/target agreement. Cells outside the sample are never inspected.

3. The probe arm ran the same fixtures through the real CLI: `catherine check --json`, plus `catherine underconstraint --max-path-length 1 --json` where the discovery questions belong to the entry; the construction probe is the same binary refusing an unparseable document.

4. Witnesses were mapped to presentation elements cell:<State>/<Event>; unique_detections = executed probe elements minus baseline-identified elements. Hypothesized underconstraint findings and executed construction rejections are recorded but never counted as detections.
5. Verdict follows the recorded rule: empty unique = killed; unique with an executed baseline arm = survived.
